questions.prompt: Explain the difference between the natural greenhouse effect and the enhanced greenhouse effect.
questions.modelAnswer: The natural greenhouse effect is caused by gases like water vapour and CO₂ that have always been in the atmosphere; they trap some outgoing infrared and keep Earth about 33 °C warmer than it would otherwise be, making life possible. The enhanced greenhouse effect is the extra warming caused by humans adding more greenhouse gases (from burning fossil fuels, deforestation, farming), which traps more heat and causes global warming.
